attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "Delete moves from a POST-only form action on Edit to a GET-linked action on the List page (now using [HttpPost] without the FormValueRequired/ActionName Edit alias), which is low risk functionally but changes the route/action name (Delete vs Edit) that other code, permissions caching, or customizations relying on the old 'submit.Delete' POST-to-Edit convention could depend on."}

reason: Delete moves from a POST-only form action on Edit to a GET-linked action on the List page (now using [HttpPost] without the FormValueRequired/ActionName Edit alias), which is low risk functionally but changes the route/action name (Delete vs Edit) that other code, permissions caching, or customizations relying on the old 'submit.Delete' POST-to-Edit convention could depend on.
